leadText: Kenji Nojima (Japanese: 野島健児 Nojima Kenji) is a Japanese voice actor for and .
plainText:
Kenji Nojima (Japanese: 野島健児 Nojima Kenji) is a Japanese voice actor for and .

==Biography==
Nojima was born on March 16, 1976 in , , and became a voice actor as an adult. His father and older brother Hirofumi are also voice actors. Nojimi began to provide voices for starting with The Legend of Thunder!, where he voiced the main protagonist . He has since gained several other roles in the and s.
